COMPACT SPECTRAL ISING MEMORY: A RESTRICTED-NOISE PHASE CANDIDATE
1 November 2026. Solo analytic derivation, with executable finite controls.
No independent audit, priority, experimental realization, or practical
advantage is asserted. Earlier Tanner and arity-transfer results are preserved.

Result and quantifiers
======================
There is an infinite family of bounded-degree graphs and a time-independent
model with n DATA qubits, 9n auxiliary qubits, TWO-BODY Hamiltonian couplings,
and ONE-BODY auxiliary losses. For a fixed locality allowance q, sufficiently
small but FIXED g/Gamma, sufficiently large but FIXED J/Gamma, and a nonzero
FIXED strong-symmetry-preserving perturbation threshold delta, the candidate
bound is

 inf_Lambda || (Dec_D x Id_CB) Phi_T (Enc_D x Id_CB)
                           - Id_Q x Lambda_CB ||_diamond
       <= min(2, C_phys n(1+T) exp(-b n/2)),                       (1)

for every T>=0 and sufficiently large n in the family. Lambda is CPTP on
the existing C,B input/output, not a replacement bath or a reinitialization.
There is ONE unknown logical qubit Q. All initial Q/C/B/reference correlations
are allowed. B is an arbitrary finite persistent bath; bounds are independent
of its dimension and reference. The data alone are ideally encoded/decoded.
The physical evolution in (1) contains the finite controllers throughout.

Crucial restriction: each allowed local Hamiltonian/jump operator commutes
with G=product_i X_i on DATA. Mere covariance of the generator under Ad_G
does not suffice. This is an algebra-restricted quantum memory; its ordinary
quantum code distance is one. It is neither a generic-noise two-body compiler
nor a positive-rate quantum code. Section 10 gives the symmetry-breaking cost.

==================================

the largest eigenvalue on the complement of the constant vector is <=17/2.
The eigenvalue -18 is harmless for this upper bound. LPS Ramanujan graphs

followed by a bipartite double cover, give an infinite family;
their nontrivial absolute eigenvalues are <=2 sqrt(17)<17/2. The finite
arithmetic construction in expander_construction.py is an illustrative member.

COMPACT SPECTRAL MEMORY: RESOURCES, COMPARATORS, AND SOURCE SCOPE
1 November 2026. Read with SPECTRAL_PHASE.txt, especially its strong-noise
algebra and symmetry-breaking counterexample. All device statements below
refer to the specified finite-dimensional Lindblad MODEL.

Physical architecture
=====================
For n data spins, the degree-18 expander has 9n data-data Ising couplers.
There are 9n auxiliary spins, 9n data-auxiliary couplers, 9n one-body
auxiliary fields and 9n one-body auxiliary loss channels. Total: 10n qubits,
18n pair couplers, maximum coupling degree 27 on data and one on auxiliaries.
Auxiliary frequencies take nine nominal values, 4J,...,36J. No physical
syndrome projectors, high-arity jumps or perturbative synthesis tree occur.
The operator-valued spectral resolvent and two-layer unitary frame are
analytical devices; they do not require hardware tables or gates.

The code stores ONE logical qubit. Its ordinary quantum distance is one.
It has large effective distance only relative to the strong algebra in
SPECTRAL_PHASE.txt. It has no positive asymptotic quantum rate. Encoding
and the final minimum-weight repetition decoder are ideal mathematical
interfaces here. Syndrome extraction, reliable quantum decoding, control
electronics, readout noise, and their wall-clock costs have not been built.
For repetition syndromes, noiseless classical reconstruction/majority can
be done in O(n) work on a connected graph; this is not a noisy decoder circuit.

The supplied finite layout is the bipartite double cover of an LPS p=17,
q=13 graph: 2,184 data vertices, 19,656 auxiliaries, 21,840 qubits total,
and 39,312 pair couplers. Exact finite arithmetic checks simplicity,
degree and connectivity. The base's computed nontrivial adjacency maximum
is 7.850855075327148. The FAMILY spectral premise comes from the LPS
theorem; the floating eigenvalue is a diagnostic, not an interval proof.
This member is not claimed to exceed the very coarse proof's minimum
block size. No dynamics of this 21,840-qubit system was simulated.
